name: National De-addiction Helpline
description: Government-listed information, counselling, guidance and referral support for people affected by substance use and their families.
source_name: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / NMBA
note: Confirm number and service details before public deployment.

name: Tele-MANAS
description: Government tele-mental-health service. For immediate life-threatening danger, use emergency services rather than waiting for support.
source_name: Directorate General of Health Services / MoHFW
note: Official sources list 14416 and 1800-89-14416; verify before launch.

name: Emergency Response Support System
description: Unified pan-India emergency number for immediate danger, including medical emergencies. Do not wait for an AI response.

name: MANAS National Narcotics Helpline
description: For reporting drug-related matters such as illegal trafficking and sale. Not a de-addiction counselling or mental-health helpline.
note: Use for drug-related reporting, not treatment.

name: Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan
description: Official information, prevention resources, public awareness materials and programme information related to substance-use prevention and support.

name: eSanjeevani
description: Government telemedicine platform. Use official instructions to determine available consultation options; it is not a specialised addiction helpline.
note: General telemedicine resource; service access can vary.

name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)
description: Official information on India's digital health ecosystem and related services. It does not replace clinical care or emergency support.

name: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
description: Official health ministry information, programmes and public-health resources.
note: Confirm specific programme page and details.

name: National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (NIMHANS)
description: National mental-health and neuroscience institute; consult its official site for verified services and educational resources.
note: Do not imply this website is an emergency helpline.
